authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s full akṣi entry names Khowar γeč(h), Gawri iċīn, Torwali aṣī and Maiya āc̣hī/ãc̣hī, as well as Punjabi/Lahnda akkh. These survey forms match the named regional affricate/sibilant series, including reduced vowels and alternative spellings of the same eye stem. Turner’s unexplained Khowar initial γ is preserved as an uncertainty; slash responses are included only when both members fit this family.

proposals.evidence: The nastaka subsection explicitly gives Kandia natho and Shina Kohistani notŭ for nose. Chilis/Gowro nothū/nothī matches this local nath-/noth- stem and final-vowel variation, rather than the nāsā or nāsikā families; the separate Torwali plural-looking nɔthɛ̃ is left for morphological review.
